resolved_conflicts.explanation: Kemnow's site includes Crow Peak among forest lookouts. The association lists the site as unknown or undocumented and moves sites to its lookout lists when evidence of regular use turns up. The story reports both views and does not decide between them.

notes_for_editor: Two thin sources. Kemnow's page gives only the county and forest; the FFLA gives the coordinates and the undocumented listing. No source describes a build date, design, staffing, use, removal, or the summit today. The story body is 106 words, below the 120-word floor, because the evidence is that thin; it may be better held back. Search results also showed a Crow Peak in the Black Hills of South Dakota; it is unrelated and was not used. The record's coordinates (44.51892, -109.94338) match the FFLA list.
